label: What we do
text: Every activity at the Senior Center is chosen to keep seniors active in body and mind, from gentle exercise and brain games to arts, music, and learning something new. Just as important, it’s a place to share laughter, snacks, and friendship, where every senior feels valued and no one is alone

label: What we do: Physical
text:
Chair exercises and gentle stretching


Balance and fall-prevention exercises


Group walks


Light dance and movement to music


Chair yoga or tai chi


Fun movement games (balloon toss, bean bag games)


Healthy snacks


Health checks and wellness talks

label: What we do: Mental
text:
Puzzles, word games, and trivia


Memory and brain-training games


Reading and storytelling circles


Learning sessions (technology, health talks, new skills)


Music, singing, and sing-alongs


Arts and crafts for creativity and focus


Group discussions and sharing life stories


Bingo, cards, and board games

label: What we do: Educational
text:
Smartphone, tablet, and video-call help (staying in touch with family)


Health, nutrition, and medication-safety talks


Scam and fraud awareness


Guest speakers from the community


Cooking and healthy-eating demonstrations


Language and conversation classes


Gardening and nature sessions


Cultural and history discussions

label: What we do: Fun & Entertainment
text:
Bingo, cards, and board games


Movie and music afternoons


Sing-alongs and karaoke


Birthday celebrations


Holiday and cultural festivals


Talent shows and storytelling


Outings and field trips


Tea, snacks, and social hours

label: Snacks & chai
text:
Light snacks
Tea and coffee
Fresh fruit
Special treats for birthdays and holidays
Prepared with care for senior dietary needs

label: Our mission
text: Every person deserves a place where they are understood, included and helped to grow. A free day program for recreation and care, Bloom Village carries Maa's spirit of unconditional care to neurodiverse individuals and the families who love them.

label: What we value
text: Belonging ("differences are welcomed, not just accommodated") · Family support ("parents, siblings and caregivers") · Growth ("skills and confidence at their own pace")

label: Who we serve
text: planned for individuals with sensory processing differences, autism, developmental delays and other special needs, together with their families, across Dallas–Fort Worth.
